metadata.description: Personal plugin marketplace for spinlockdevelopment — Claude Code skills and slash commands for project lifecycle, developer environments, and deployment-target references.

plugins.name: spindev-core
plugins.description: Session / project-lifecycle primitives: /end-session, /init-project, /pr-prepass, /review-plan, plus the gh skill and the pr-prepass subagent. Includes a non-blocking gh-workflow PreToolUse hook for advisory checks on gh + git push.

plugins.name: spindev-devenv
plugins.description: Developer-machine setup: hardened-shell Docker sandbox and ubuntu-debloat bringup.

plugins.name: spindev-deploy
plugins.description: Deployment-platform reference skills (flyio, sprites-dev) with PreToolUse hooks (sprite-guard, fly-guard) that catch documented failure modes at execution time.
